market.description:
Trading pair code representing the market.

[Example]: "SGD-BTC"

candle_date_time_utc.description:
Start time of the candle period in UTC.

[Format]: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss

opening_price.description:
The opening price of the candle,
representing the first trading price during the candle period.

high_price.description:
The highest trading price,
recorded during the candle period.

low_price.description:
The lowest trading price,
recorded during the candle period.

trade_price.description: The closing price of the candle, representing the last trading price during the candle period.

timestamp.description: The timestamp (in milliseconds) when the last tick of the candle was recorded.

candle_acc_trade_price.description: The total trade amount (in the quoted currency) accumulated during the candle period.

candle_acc_trade_volume.description: The total traded volume (in the base asset) accumulated during the candle period.
